Extracting bus stops within SIngapore only

Need to convert EPSG code first


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
BusStop <- st_transform(BusStop, crs = 3414)
BusStop_in_SG <- st_join(
  BusStop, mpsz, 
  join = st_within,
  left = FALSE
)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(mpsz) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(BusStop_in_SG) +
  tm_dots()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In_Class_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


Deriving Analytical Hexagon


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon <- st_make_grid(mpsz,
                        cellsize = 700,
                        what = "polygon",
                        square = FALSE) %>%
  st_sf()
```
:::


FIltering hexagons with bus stops


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon$n_collisions = 
  lengths(st_intersects(
    hexagon, BusStop_in_SG
  ))

hexagon <- filter(hexagon, n_collisions >0)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon <- hexagon %>%
  select(, n_collisions)

hexagon$HEX_ID <- sprintf(
  "H%04d", seq_len(nrow(hexagon))) %>%
  as.factor()

kable(head(hexagon))
```
